description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures are not implemented based on access restrictions.
applicability: Applies to organizations that do not implement secure authentication mechanisms appropriate to the sensitivity of information and systems, including lack of multi-factor authentication (MFA), weak password policies, or insecure authentication protocols.

metadata.detection_notes: Review authentication mechanisms, password policies, multi-factor authentication (MFA) implementation, authentication protocols (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect), password strength requirements, account lockout policies, and authentication logging.
